title: ConstantSubsheafNormalizedPresentation
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space whose compact opens are stable under binary intersection. Let $\iota:K\to C$ be a monomorphism of abelian sheaves, let $\alpha:C\simeq\underline{\mathbb Z}$ identify $C$ with the constant integer sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and suppose $K$ is generated by finitely many integer extensions by zero on compact opens [def-sc-abelian-open-extension-by-zero]. Fix isomorphisms $e_x:C_x\simeq\mathbb Z$ of stalks [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] and $b\in\mathbb N$ such that every image $e_x\iota_x(K_x)$ has generator at most $b+1$. There exist $n\in\mathbb N$, compact opens $A_i$ for $i\in\operatorname{Fin}(n)$, positive labels $c_i\leq b+1$, and an epimorphism $g:\bigoplus_i j_{A_i!}\underline{\mathbb Z}\to K$. Let $s_i\in K(A_i)$ be the image under its $i$th component of the canonical unit section of $j_{A_i!}\underline{\mathbb Z}$ over $A_i$. Its image under $\alpha\iota$ is the constant section $c_i$. At every point in $\bigcup_i A_i$, some active label $c_i$ divides every active label $c_j$ (active means the point lies in $A_j$).
